meta.title: Flatpare — compare apartments together

privacy.title: What we can and can't see
privacy.claim: We can't read your data. We do process PDFs and addresses in memory when you ask us to, and we never store them.
privacy.encryptedBody: Every listing, rating, note and PDF is encrypted in your browser before it's stored, with a key the server never holds. What we keep is ciphertext: without your passphrase or recovery code nobody can read it, us included.
privacy.seesIntro: What the server does see is what it needs to keep your household apart from everyone else's:
privacy.seesAccount: your account: email address, and the name you set;
privacy.seesCounts: how many apartments, ratings and places you have, who rated what, and when each was added or changed;
privacy.seesPdfSize: the size of each stored PDF.
privacy.seesNever: Never what an apartment is. Self-hosted, the same holds with your own server in our place.
privacy.exceptionIntro: A few things cannot be done in a browser. For those, that single item is sent in readable form, used for that one call, never written to our database and never logged:
privacy.exceptionPdf: A PDF goes to an AI model that reads the facts out and writes a short summary. On flatpare.com that is through Vercel AI Gateway with zero data retention: it only uses model providers that have agreed not to keep the request. Self-hosted, it is Google Gemini unless you configure another.
privacy.exceptionAddress: An address goes to Google Maps, for its location and the bike and transit times (OpenRouteService on a self-hosted setup without Maps).
privacy.exceptionListing: A listing's link is opened by our server, which fetches the page from the listing site to check it is still online.
privacy.tiles: Maps load their streets from OpenFreeMap or OpenStreetMap, which see the part of the city on screen, never your apartments.
privacy.disavowal: That is why we do not describe this as zero-knowledge.

hosted.body: Everything is encrypted in your browser before it's stored, with a key the server never holds (<link>what that means</link>). Nothing to install, no API keys to manage.
hosted.thenOnce: then a one-time payment · per household · not a subscription
hosted.once: one-time payment · per household · not a subscription
hosted.betaKeep: Request access below. What a beta account gets is yours to keep: neither your data nor your credits are taken back when the beta ends.
hosted.more: Need more? Another CHF 5 adds another 40 apartments.
hosted.quota: The 40 counts apartments you add: deleting one does not give the credit back.
hosted.noReset: Your key comes from your passphrase, plus a recovery code you print. There is no reset — lose both and the data is gone, to us too.

selfHost.body: Your server, your database, your keys. Host it on a laptop, a home server or your own cloud account — your search never leaves your setup, and there are no limits.
selfHost.keys: bring your own Gemini & Maps keys

pdf.title: PDF in, facts out
pdf.body: Upload an exposé and rent, rooms, size and address are filled in for you.

rate.title: Rate on your own
rate.body: Each person scores separately; the ratings sit side by side so you can see where you agree.

grid.body: Sort, hide and compare every listing until the winner is obvious.

commutes.title: Commutes, calculated
commutes.body: Bike and transit times to up to five places that matter to you.

household.title: Built for a household
household.body: Made for partners and flatmates searching together, not for teams or agents.

private.title: Private either way
